notes.note: Title of the dialog that decommissions one host, and its confirm button.
Explains what decommissioning one host does.

segment.source: A decommissioned host is retired but kept on record. Its addresses are released, what is observed about it raises no proposals and the default lists leave it out. You can reinstate it later.
segment.target: En avvecklad värd tas ur bruk men finns kvar i registret. Dess adresser frigörs, det som observeras om den ger inga förslag och standardlistorna döljer den. Du kan återaktivera den senare.

notes.note: Explains what decommissioning several hosts does.

segment.source: Decommissioned hosts are retired but kept on record. Their addresses are released, what is observed about them raises no proposals and the default lists leave them out. You can reinstate them later.
segment.target: Avvecklade värdar tas ur bruk men finns kvar i registret. Deras adresser frigörs, det som observeras om dem ger inga förslag och standardlistorna döljer dem. Du kan återaktivera dem senare.

segment.source: By default the DNS records of the released addresses are removed. Tick this to leave them in place.
segment.target: Som standard tas DNS-posterna för de frigjorda adresserna bort. Markera rutan för att låta dem ligga kvar.

segment.source: Both claims stay, and the conflict is not raised again while the same devices share the address. Another device on the address opens it again.

The host cannot be reinstated because it is not decommissioned.
